svg.title: Quest log: experience and leadership
svg.desc: Backend AI Intern, FlyRank AI (Jul 2026 – now). Backend engineering on an AI product. Technical Lead · VIT Pune, AWS Student Builder Group (Oct 2026 – now). Leads client projects for startups and industry partners, including the production website for Daily Bread, a Mumbai-based wellness-beverage startup; runs delivery and workshops for a 128-member club. Web Development Member · VIT Pune, Google Developer Group (Nov 2025 – now). Led a team of 25 developers to design and deploy two full-stack platforms, a campus Placement Portal and Parkomate (smart parking); runs code reviews and CI/CD with GitHub Actions. Contingent Leader, Mood Indigo · IIT Bombay (Nov – Dec 2025). Led the college contingent at Asia's largest college cultural festival. Full-Stack Developer, Freelance (2025 – 2026). Shipped client work end to end, including a tour agency website and a production-line app for a manufacturer.
